title: Français 3516 — La Boderie, f59r–60v
contents: A report from England on negotiations in the Low Countries, expressing concern about placing too much hope in one course of action.
status: 4/4 pages transcribed; 3/4 cipher pages deciphered; 1 more in part
fields: 112 symbols:57 letter signs,53 word or syllable codes,2 controls.

excerpt: **assez mal fondees, de sorte que tant s’en faut que je me promette rien de bien de ce commerage. J’ai peur qu’il ne produise que du mespris de part et d’autre, et de part et d’autre il semble que on y chemine que par maniere d’acquit.**
translation: Quite ill-founded, so that I am far from expecting any good from this godparent relationship. I fear that it will produce only contempt on both sides, and on both sides it seems that people are merely going through the motions.
